# SHRAVIKO — Premium Indian Pooja Essentials

## About
SHRAVIKO is an Indian e-commerce brand specializing in handcrafted pooja (worship) essentials.
Based in Udaipur, Rajasthan, India. GSTIN: 08CODPJ2489F1ZT.
Website: https://shraviko.com
Contact: info@shraviko.com | +91 7742320607

## Product Categories
- Brass Articles: Pooja bells, thalis, diyas, kalash, kamandal, singhasan, idols
- Copper Articles: Panchpatra sets, pooja thalis, hawan kunds, kalash
- Mandir Essentials: Rudraksha/Sphatik/Tulsi/Vaijanti malas, wooden chowkis, dhoopdani, japa counters
- Vastu & Spiritual: Yantras (Ganesh, Kuber, Lakshmi, Shani), pyramids, crystal items
- Corporate & Bulk Gifting: Curated spiritual gift hampers
- Energy Stones & Bracelets: Natural gemstone and crystal bracelets

## Sourcing & Materials
All brass articles are 100% solid virgin brass from Moradabad.
All copper articles are 99.6% pure copper.
Malas use authentic Himalayan Rudraksha, Vrindavan Tulsi, and natural Sphatik.
All products are Made in India.
